jobs.name: Rebuild indicators
jobs.description: Recalculate reusable strategy inputs for a completed date range.

fields.label: Start date
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: End date
fields.explanation: Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.

fields.label: Strategies
fields.help: Select the strategies whose inputs should be rebuilt.
fields.explanation: Strategy IDs whose research inputs or rankings should be calculated.

jobs.needs: Stored market history and an active strategy.
jobs.result: Indicator inputs ready for strategy research.
jobs.when: Use after new price data arrives or indicator definitions change. This prepares reusable inputs; use Rebuild strategy rankings afterward to publish scores and ranks.

jobs.name: Rebuild strategy rankings
jobs.description: Calculate strategy factors and rankings for selected completed sessions.

fields.label: Start date
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: End date
fields.explanation: Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.

fields.label: Strategies
fields.help: Select the strategies whose inputs should be rebuilt.
fields.explanation: Strategy IDs whose research inputs or rankings should be calculated.

fields.label: Completed trading sessions
fields.help: Comma-separated session dates. In the app, these should come from the stored trading calendar.
fields.explanation: Explicit trading sessions to process; sorted, unique, and within the requested range when a range is supplied.

jobs.needs: Indicator inputs and historical market prices.
jobs.result: Published rankings for the selected sessions.
jobs.when: Use when you need updated momentum research for specific sessions and its indicator inputs are ready. Daily Positional Trend signals use their dedicated job.

jobs.name: Build Positional Trend signals
jobs.description: Calculate daily trend signals for one completed session.

fields.label: Signal session
fields.explanation: The completed session used for signals, coverage, or dated calculations.

fields.label: Stock universe
fields.explanation: The universe of stocks to use when calculating trend signals.

jobs.needs: Universe membership and sufficient OHLC history.
jobs.result: Daily trend signals available in stock rankings.
jobs.when: Use for one completed trading session when you want fresh daily entry and trend signals.

jobs.name: Build Positional Trend over sessions
jobs.description: Build daily signals for several explicitly selected trading sessions.

fields.label: Completed trading sessions
fields.help: Comma-separated session dates. In the app, these should come from the stored trading calendar.
fields.explanation: Explicit trading sessions to process; sorted, unique, and within the requested range when a range is supplied.

fields.label: Stock universe
fields.explanation: The universe of stocks to use when calculating trend signals.

jobs.needs: Market history covering all selected sessions.
jobs.result: Trend signals for each selected session.
jobs.when: Use to rebuild daily trend signals for an explicit set of past sessions without rebuilding every other research output.

jobs.name: Prepare research prerequisites
jobs.description: Prepare reference data and historical prices before strategy calculations.

fields.label: Start date
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: End date
fields.explanation: Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.

jobs.needs: Configured market-data access for data collection.
jobs.result: Prerequisite market and reference data prepared.
jobs.when: Use to prepare data prerequisites as a standalone operation before running research calculations.

jobs.name: Refresh NIFTY 500 membership
jobs.description: Collect a dated stock-universe snapshot.

fields.label: Collection date
fields.explanation: Collection date of the membership snapshot. This does not reconstruct membership from an arbitrary historical date.

jobs.needs: Access to the NSE reference-data source.
jobs.result: A saved universe snapshot.
jobs.when: Use when the screening universe needs a new membership collection. The source is current membership; requesting a past date does not supply a historically accurate past list.

jobs.name: Resolve snapshot instruments
jobs.description: Match a saved stock snapshot to Kite instrument identities.

fields.label: Universe snapshot ID
fields.explanation: Identity of an existing saved universe snapshot.

jobs.needs: An existing snapshot and market-data Kite connection.
jobs.result: Resolved instruments and any unmatched symbols.
jobs.when: Use after collecting a snapshot to resolve its stocks to provider instrument identities before price collection.

jobs.name: Fetch history for one stock
jobs.description: Download historical OHLCV bars for a tracked stock.

fields.label: Stock symbol
fields.explanation: Tracked exchange stock symbol, such as RELIANCE.

fields.label: Exchange
fields.explanation: Exchange on which the instrument is tracked.

fields.label: Start date
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: End date
fields.explanation: Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.

jobs.needs: A tracked instrument and market-data Kite connection.
jobs.result: Historical price bars and quality diagnostics.
jobs.when: Use to fill missing history or refresh a specific tracked stock without collecting the entire universe.

jobs.name: Refresh history for all stocks
jobs.description: Schedule historical data collection for the tracked stock universe.

fields.label: Start date
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: End date
fields.explanation: Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.

jobs.needs: Resolved stock instruments and market-data access.
jobs.result: Scheduled collection jobs; inspect their completion separately.
jobs.when: Use when many tracked stocks need new historical prices. Completion means collection jobs have been scheduled; inspect those jobs for the actual data outcome.

jobs.name: Check market-data coverage
jobs.description: Check reference identities and historical session coverage.

fields.label: Coverage starts
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: Coverage ends
fields.explanation: The completed session used for signals, coverage, or dated calculations.

jobs.needs: Stored reference identities and market bars.
jobs.result: A coverage report showing missing or inconsistent data.
jobs.when: Use when you suspect missing market sessions, unresolved symbols, or inconsistent reference identities. It checks coverage rather than collecting missing prices.

jobs.name: Detect corporate actions
jobs.description: Collect and classify corporate actions in a date window.

fields.label: From
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: Through
fields.explanation: The completed session used for signals, coverage, or dated calculations.

jobs.needs: Access to corporate-action reference data.
jobs.result: Detected actions ready for processing.
jobs.when: Use to identify splits, bonuses, and other reported events before their related adjustments are processed.

jobs.name: Process detected corporate actions
jobs.description: Process actionable corporate events already detected by the app.
jobs.needs: Detected corporate actions and historical price access.
jobs.result: Processed events and related quality evidence.
jobs.when: Use after detection to process pending actionable corporate events. Inspect the result and quality evidence afterward.

jobs.name: Run a strategy backtest
jobs.description: Simulate a strategy over a historical date range.

fields.label: Strategy
fields.explanation: The active strategy used for this operation.

fields.label: Start date
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: End date
fields.explanation: Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.

fields.label: Starting capital (₹)
fields.explanation: Initial simulation capital in rupees.

fields.label: Maximum holdings
fields.explanation: Maximum concurrent holdings in the simulation, subject to strategy rules.

jobs.needs: Published strategy inputs and sufficient market history.
jobs.result: A simulation report with performance and trades.
jobs.when: Use for a historical performance simulation. Review data coverage, costs, and stop assumptions before interpreting its results.

jobs.name: Attribute backtest returns
jobs.description: Break down a saved backtest’s returns.

fields.label: Saved backtest run ID
fields.explanation: Identity of the saved backtest whose results should be analysed.

jobs.needs: A completed saved backtest.
jobs.result: Return attribution for the saved run.
jobs.when: Use after a backtest completes to understand which instruments and classifications contributed to returns. Optional classification artifacts can enrich the result.

jobs.name: Refresh index quotes
jobs.description: Read quotes for tracked benchmark indices.
jobs.needs: Tracked index identities and market-data Kite connection.
jobs.result: Updated index quotes.
jobs.when: Use when tracked benchmark quotes need refreshing. This is a quote refresh, not a persistent streaming connection.

jobs.name: Check portfolio stop alerts
jobs.description: Check current holding prices against their recorded stops.

fields.label: Portfolio account ID
fields.explanation: Identity of the portfolio whose holdings or proposals should be processed.

jobs.needs: An existing portfolio, recorded stops, and quote access.
jobs.result: Stop alerts for review; no order is submitted by this job.
jobs.when: Use to check current portfolio quotes against recorded stop thresholds and create alert evidence for review.

jobs.name: Generate trade proposals
jobs.description: Prepare proposed trades for an account and target session.

fields.label: Portfolio account ID
fields.explanation: Identity of the portfolio whose holdings or proposals should be processed.

fields.label: Strategy
fields.explanation: The active strategy used for this operation.

fields.label: Target session
fields.explanation: Target trading session for the generated proposals; research comes from completed data.

jobs.needs: Account history and completed strategy research.
jobs.result: Reviewable trade proposals, rather than executed orders.
jobs.when: Use when completed research is available and you want proposed trades for an account’s next target session. Review the proposals separately before execution.

jobs.name: Recover artifact publications
jobs.description: Recover interrupted artifact publications.
jobs.needs: An existing local artifact store.
jobs.result: Recovery summary for interrupted publications.
jobs.when: Use after an interrupted publication when research artifacts may not have completed their publication lifecycle.

jobs.name: Advance an existing pipeline
jobs.description: Ask the coordinator to advance an existing research pipeline.

fields.label: Pipeline ID
fields.explanation: Identity of an existing tracked research pipeline.

jobs.needs: An existing pipeline with completed prerequisite stages.
jobs.result: Updated pipeline stage status.
jobs.when: Use to resume coordination of a known pipeline whose prerequisite stages have finished. Prefer the full pipeline interface for creating a new run.

jobs.name: Test job processing
jobs.description: Echo a payload to verify the job-processing flow.
jobs.needs: A running worker.
jobs.result: The submitted payload is returned unchanged.
jobs.when: Use to confirm that job submission and worker processing function before troubleshooting a domain-specific job.

parameters.explanation: Sample data to echo back when checking worker processing.

jobs.name: Fetch bars for an instrument batch
jobs.description: Collect market history for an explicit instrument batch.
jobs.needs: Tracked instrument records in items and market-data access.
jobs.result: Batch collection summary.
jobs.when: Use for a bounded, explicit batch of tracked instruments when the all-symbol refresh is too broad.

parameters.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.
Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.
Instrument records for a bulk history request. Supply the identities required by the batch handler.

jobs.name: Build a liquidity-filtered universe
jobs.description: Evaluate a supplied instrument and bar set against a liquidity policy.
jobs.needs: A valid liquidity policy, instrument records, and bar records.
jobs.result: Eligible universe and exclusion reasons.
jobs.when: Use when you already have instrument and bar records and want to apply a specific liquidity policy to them.

parameters.explanation: The completed session used for signals, coverage, or dated calculations.
Liquidity policy with thresholds and required lookback settings.
Instrument identity records to evaluate against the liquidity policy.
Historical OHLCV records required by the liquidity calculation.

jobs.name: Detect holdings leaving the universe
jobs.description: Compare held instrument identities with a universe snapshot.
jobs.needs: A saved snapshot and held instrument IDs.
jobs.result: Universe-exit evidence for held stocks.
jobs.when: Use after a universe change to identify held stocks that are absent from the selected membership snapshot.

parameters.explanation: Identity of an existing saved universe snapshot.
Instrument IDs currently held, to compare with the saved membership snapshot.

jobs.name: Stress-test backtest assumptions
jobs.description: Run a base simulation with a set of scenario overrides.
jobs.needs: Valid base parameters and 1–10 scenarios.
jobs.result: Scenario comparison reports.
jobs.when: Use to compare how a baseline simulation behaves under alternative costs, capital, or supported execution assumptions.

parameters.explanation: Shared simulation parameters such as strategy, capital, costs, and dates where required.
Named stress cases with supported parameter overrides; use 1–10 scenarios.

jobs.name: Run walk-forward windows
jobs.description: Evaluate a base strategy across rolling train and test windows.
jobs.needs: Valid base strategy parameters and 1–20 dated windows.
jobs.result: Window-by-window simulation reports.
jobs.when: Use to compare strategy results across successive train and test windows, rather than relying on one historical period.

parameters.explanation: Shared simulation parameters such as strategy, capital, costs, and dates where required.
Named train/test windows with train_start, train_end, test_start, and test_end; use 1–20 windows.

pipeline.name: Full research pipeline
pipeline.description: Prepare data and run both momentum research and daily trend signals in a tracked sequence.

fields.label: Start date
fields.explanation: First date to include in the requested window.

fields.label: End date
fields.explanation: Last date to include. Historical research uses completed sessions.

fields.label: Strategies
fields.help: Select the strategies whose inputs should be rebuilt.
fields.explanation: Strategy IDs whose research inputs or rankings should be calculated.

fields.label: Prepare market data first
fields.explanation: Whether the full pipeline should prepare market-data prerequisites first.

pipeline.needs: Market-data access when preparation is enabled.
pipeline.result: Completed research stages and published strategy results.
pipeline.when: Use for an end-to-end research update when you want prerequisites and both strategy outputs coordinated as a single run.
